verdict.rationale: Community Phone documents a few fixed, user-configurable telephony rules that act on call events. Unanswered calls can roll to other numbers or ring several at once, and users can set call forwarding, advanced call routing, dial menus, allow/block lists and scheduled automated check-in calls. None of this amounts to a general rule engine where users define their own triggers and actions, and no API was found (OpenAPI probes returned 404). missing for 10: general user-defined trigger/condition/action rules, events beyond call handling (e.g., texts and voicemails triggering custom actions), programmatic or AI-agent-accessible automation configuration, independent corroboration.
